name: Carsten Korth
abstract_title: Tool evolution as a prerequisite for consciousness
abstract: Fundamental assumptions If we consider the late emergence of consciousness is an advanced product of Darwinian evolution, we must come to the insight that the emergence of consciousness was gradual, i. e. that there were intermediate precursors to full consciousness. The distinction of state and content consciousness helps to clarify the idea that beyond wakefulness (i. e. “state consciousness”) there is another dimension that is significantly different along an evolutionary trajectory of specie
